remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature" [notes backing inscription 1]. Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscriptions 1–3. The O'Keeffe–Halpert correspondence at Archive of American Art indicates that O'Keeffe decided to varnish her works on her own in the 1960s; "My First Effort" in inscription 3 may refer in some way to her doing so, but the exact meaning of the phrase is not clear. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Alfred Stieglitz Collection, Bequest of Georgia O'Keeffe, 1986
description: Cliffs with alternating red, yellow, and tan strata fill the frame. At the bottom and top of the cliffs, rippling hills dotted with green bushes stretch across the composition. Small slivers of blue sky are visible above the cliffs.
